content:
The **Green Line** is a series of bus stops throughout Appalachia.

Part of the transportation system of the region, the Green Line consists of bus stops in four cities. The shelters are green in color and have line signage on the front. Underneath the shelters are trash cans, news stands, Nuka-Cola Machines, and seating.

At the Abandoned Bog Town location, a skeleton is found on the roof with a hammer. Two letters have fallen and can be found on the ground below.

The Green Line appears in *Fallout 76*.
